title: Motivational wallet
tagline: Motivational Contract - lose your fund if your self-imposed goals are not met
description:
A contract that reads an event from an oracle and if it sees it as failed, will send the entire contents of the wallet to an irrecoverable eth wallet. Otherwise, after a certain amount of time, it will send it back to the original wallet.

Use cases for this involve setting personal goals with money at stake.
how_its_made: It uses the Tatum SDK and Uma Oracle. The Tatum SDK made development easy by how comprehensive the library is. It was also a good learning opportunity as it is the first time I have used oracles. By generating a wallet using the API key, and having simple logic to check the oracle contract, we could combine this together for the desired result.
